mappings.name: [EOL] BALA ESP32 Development Mini Self-balancing Car
mappings.notes: Exact K014-B shop specification establishes16MB Flash/4MB PSRAM/ILI9341. Current app/bala page labelsSKU K014 and corroborates only the family; it cannot be relabeled as exact K014-B. K007/K007-V26/K007-V27 catalog displays are ILI9342C. No parent is silently substituted, no8MB PSRAM inherited. Exact legacy board revision remains unknown; this documented configuration needs its own K014-B adaptation.

mappings.name: BALA2 Fire Self-balancing Robot Kit
